density_audit.scope: Reserve the indicated symbolic infinite families; cover the whole 10 mod 42 class using only spare 7-smooth moduli. Does not exclude overlap-assisted or rearranged repairs, or release of powers after finite truncation.

partial_replacements.recipe: Start with the unit set. For each prime p with fixed exponent e, retain the old list, append the p^j copies of each old set (j=1..e, residue matching the progression), then append arrow groups of consecutive old sets in batches of p-1, starting at exponent e+1 with the progression prefix. Discard an incomplete final batch. At the root use q-arrow on the first q-1 final sets. Finitize with auxiliary primes distinct from all construction primes and from each other.

partial_union_uncovered_progression.scope: Uncovered by the six new partial-cover schemas, including their stated finite closures. Not certified uncovered by Owens retained classes.

partial_fixed_shape_larger_prime_barrier.scope: This one-stage-per-prime counting rule on a single class mod 840; all larger root primes also excluded by induction B(next)=B(q)*q/(q-1). Not an obstruction to other constructions.

limitations: Searches use a restricted one-stage-per-prime set-building rule.
The uniform tests freeze base primes at 89 and do not reuse later fresh primes as bases.
The partial union is not a full replacement for 42.
Original later-stage overlaps and rearrangements are not encoded.
Owens full construction has not been independently verified.
